backend/main.mo: Actor defining vehicle inspections, user profiles, authorization, storage, and review workflows with CRUD and permission-checked query/update methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs for camera capture and settings integration.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of various frontend React components, hooks, utilities, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global style definitions with OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes and UI elements.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that loads the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React root handling authentication, profile loading, initial setup flow, and rendering the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/CameraCaptureDia: Camera capture modal providing live preview, device enumeration, quality settings, error handling, and conversion to ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer displaying copyright and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/FormalReportView: Displays a printable formal inspection report with editable letterhead and controls for printing or saving as PDF.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Renders the app header with authentication controls and displays the current user’s profile info.
frontend/src/components/InspectionDetail: Shows detailed inspection info, allows insurance officers to approve or reject reports, and opens the formal report view.
frontend/src/components/InspectionForm.t: Form for inspectors to create and submit new vehicle inspections with photos and validation.
Lists inspection summaries and opens a detailed dialog for viewing each inspection.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for first‑time users to create their profile by submitting name and role.
frontend/src/components/ReviewQueue.tsx: Displays pending vehicle inspections and allows selecting one for detailed review using a modal dialog.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login/logout handling, and identity persistence via a React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor calls with React Query hooks for fetching and mutating inspections, profiles, and letterhead info.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, CSS variables for themes, dark mode overrides, and print-specific rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the main dashboard with tabs for reports, inspection creation, and review workflows based on user role.
frontend/src/utils/cameraSettings.ts: Manages camera preference storage and provides resolution/quality presets for image capture.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters from query or hash, persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them when needed.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, layout settings, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s state, including features, new requests, and metadata for the camera capture and settings project.
